newsitem.title: UK: Delta jumps after maintaining dividend.
newsitem.headline: Delta jumps after maintaining dividend.

text.p: Shares in Delta Plc were up 22-1/2p, or 6.38 percent, by 0855 GMT after the company reported full-year profits at the top end of analysts's expectations and maintained its dividend, dealers said.
"Some people were looking for a lower result and a much more bearish outlook," one senior dealer said. "The figures were not too bad considering the market conditions and they held the dividend."
The engineering products manufacturer and industrial services group reported 1996 pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits of 57.2 million stg versus 64.1 million stg a year ago.
The total dividend was unchanged at 18.9 pence.
